summary: Configured node1 to back up /srv/inventory/data daily at 02:00 local time into /var/backups/inventory, retaining exactly the seven newest archives. Backup integrity and persistence across a node reboot were verified.
actions_performed: Installed /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup with atomic archive creation and retention pruning.
Installed and enabled persistent systemd service and timer units.
Created and validated backups against the source SHA-256 hashes.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed the boot identity changed and backup operation recovered.

evidence.summary: The timer is enabled, active, persistent, valid, and scheduled daily at 02:00.
The backup service succeeded; the archive was valid and its extracted files exactly matched both source-file hashes.

evidence.requirement: Retain the seven most recent backups
evidence.summary: After more than seven runs, exactly seven archives remained and the oldest was pruned; the count remained seven after reboot and another backup.
These commands show the healthy pre-restart state, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart recovery with an active timer and a successful integrity-checked backup.
